fields.title: Engeri Amaanyi ag'Omwoyo Gye Gafiirwa
fields.body_html:
Enkubaganya y'ebirowoozo yonna ku Kubatizibwa n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'amaanyi agava mu kwo yandibadde ng'etajjuvu singa tetwogera ku kyo nti amaanyi ag'omwoyo gayinza okufiirwa. Olumu ku lugero olw'ekitalo era olusaddaaza ennyo mu Ndagaano Enkadde lwe lwa Samusooni. Era lwe lumu ku ngeri esomesa ennyo. Yali asinga ddala okwatiikirira mu bantu b'ekiseera kye. Emikisa emikulu gyali mibikkule gy'ali, naye oluvannyuma lw'okuwangula okw'ekiseera, obulamu bwe bwakoma mu kugwa okusaddaaza, byonna olw'obusiru bwe ye.

Emirundi n'emirundi kigambibwa ku ye nti "Omwoyo wa Mukama n'amukkako n'amaanyi," era olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo ogwo, yakola eby'ekyewuunyo, ng'eewuunyisa abantu be era ng'awangula abalabe ba Mukama, naye mu Balamuzi 16:19-20, tumulaba ng'alekeddwa Mukama, newankubadde nga takimanyi, amaanyi ge nga gamuvuddeko era ng'anaatera okutwalibwa mu buwambe obw'ennaku, ekyokuzannyisa eri abatatya Katonda, era n'okufa n'abalabe ba Mukama okufa okw'obukambwe era okw'obuswavu.

Eky'ennaku, Samusooni si ye musajja yekka mu byafaayo by'Ekikristaayo eyamala okumanya amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, oluvannyuma n'amwolwako amaanyi gano n'aggibwako. Waaliwo ba Samusooni bangi, era ndowooza waliba abasajja abalala bangi Katonda be yamala okukozesa oluvannyuma n'awalirizibwa okubaggyako.

Kimu ku bintu ebisaddaaza ennyo ku nsi kwe kulaba omusajja bw'atyo. Katutunuulire ekiseera Mukama lw'ava ku muntu oba lw'amuggyako amaanyi ge, oba mu ngeri endala, "Engeri amaanyi gye gafiirwa."

I. Okusooka, Katonda aggya amaanyi ge ku basajja bwe bakyuka ne bava ku kwawulibwa kwabwe eri Ye. Kino kye kyali ddala eri Samusooni yennyini. (Balamuzi 16:19, Okubala 6:2, 5). Enviiri ze ezitaasalibwako kye kyali ekyokulabikira eky'obweyamo bwe obw'Obunaziri, kwe yali "yeeyawulira Mukama." Okusala enviiri ze kwe kwali okuwaayo okwawulibwa kwe. Okwawulibwa kwe kwaggibwawo; n'aggyibwako amaanyi ge. Ku kifo kino kye kimu abasajja bangi leero bagibwako amaanyi gaabwe. Waaliwo olunaku lwe yeeyawulira Katonda. Yakuba amabega eri ensi n'okwegomba kwayo, omwoyo gwayo, ebigendererwa byayo; ne yeeteeka wa ku bbali eri Katonda ng'omutukuvu gy'ali, okuba owuwe, Katonda amutwale amukozese era amukole ky'ayagala. Katonda yassaamu ekitiibwa okwawulibwa kwe. Yamusiiga amafuta g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'amaanyi. Yamanyiira Katonda. Naye Derira n'amujjira. Ensi n'ewamba omutima gwe nate. Yawuliriza eddoboozi ly'ensi eriwabya n'akkiriza n'amumwako akabonero k'okwawulibwa.

Yali takyali musajja yawuddwa, oba omutukuvu ddala eri Mukama, era Mukama n'amuleka.

Tewali bantu ng'abo mu abo abasoma kino? Basajja ne bakazi, Mukama be yamala okukozesa, naye kaakano takyabakozesa. Muyinza okuba nga mukyali mu mulimu ogw'Ekikristaayo mu maaso, naye tewali ddembe n'amaanyi ag'edda mu gwo, era ensonga eno kubanga mubadde batali beesigwa eri okwawulibwa kwammwe, eri okwewaayo kwammwe eri Katonda; muwuliriza Derira, eddoboozi ly'omwenzi, ensi n'okukemebwa kwayo. Wandyagadde okukomyawo amaanyi ag'edda? Waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka eky'okukola. Leka enviiri zo zikule nate, nga Samusooni bwe yakola. Zza obuggya okwewaayo kwo eri Katonda.

2. Amaanyi gafiirwa okuyita mu kuyingira kw'ekibi. Kyali bwe kityo eri Sawulo, mutabani wa Kiisi.

Omwoyo wa Katonda ne akka ku Sawulo, n'awangula okuwangula okunene ku lwa Katonda. (1 Samwiri 11:6). Yatwala abantu ba Katonda okubatuusa mu kifo eky'obuwanguzi ku balabe baabwe, abaali babanyigirizza okumala emyaka.

Naye Sawulo yajeemera Katonda mu bifo bibiri eby'enjawulo (1 Samwiri 13-14, 9-11, 23), Mukama n'amuggyako ekisa kye n'amaanyi ge, era obulamu bwa Sawulo ne bukoma mu kuwangulwa n'okuzikirira kwenkanidde.

Kino kye kyafaayo eky'abasajja bangi Katonda be yamala okukozesa. Ekibi kyayingira. Baakola ekyo Katonda kye yabagamba obutakola, oba baagaana okukola ekyo Katonda kye yabalagira okukola, era amaanyi ga Katonda ne gaggibwawo.

Oyo eyamala okumanya amaanyi ga Katonda mu buweereza era ayagala okugeeyongera okugamanya ateekwa okutambula n'obwegendereza ennyo mu maaso ge. Ateekwa okuba nga awuliriza bulijjo okuwulira Katonda ky'amulagira okukola oba obutakola. Ateekwa okuyanukula amangu eri obuŋŋunda obutono ennyo obwa Katonda. Kandirabise nga omuntu yenna eyamala okumanya amaanyi ga Katonda yandisinze okufa okusinga okugafiirwa. Naye gafiirwa okuyita mu kuyingira kw'ekibi. Waliwo ku basoma ekitabo kino abayita mu kyokutegeera kino eky'entiisa eky'okufiirwa amaanyi ga Katonda? Weebuuze oba eno y'ensonga; ekibi kiyingidde wamu? Okola ekintu, oboolyawo ekintu ekitono, Katonda ky'akugamba obutakola? Ogaya ekintu Katonda kye yakusaba okukola? Kituukirize kino ekigambo ne Katonda, era amaanyi ag'edda galikomawo.

Dawudi yazza omusango ogw'ekibi eky'entiisa, naye ekibi ekyo bwe kyayatulwa ne kiggyibwawo, yaddamu okumanya amaanyi g'Omwoyo. (Zabbuli 32:1-5; Zabbuli 51:11-13). Bwe twandyagadde okumanya obutasalako amaanyi ga Katonda, twandigenze emirundi mingi twekka ne Ye, waakiri ku nkomerero ya buli lunaku, ne tumusaba atulage oba waliwo ekibi kyonna, ekintu kyonna ekitasanyusa mu maaso ge, ekiyingidde ku lunaku olwo, era bw'atulaga nti waliwo, twandikyatudde ne tukiggyawo mu kiseera ekyo kyennyini.

3. Amaanyi gafiirwa nate okuyita mu kwemalira. Oyo ayagala amaanyi ga Katonda ateekwa okubeera n'obulamu obw'okwefiiriza. Waliwo ebintu bingi ebitali bibi mu ngeri gy'ekigambo ekibi bwe kitera okutegeerebwa, naye ebiziyiza obw'omwoyo era ebiggya abasajja amaanyi. Sikkiriza nti omuntu yenna ayinza okubeera n'obulamu obw'ebbeeyi, okwewemberako mu kwegomba kwe okw'obuzaale, okwenyumiriza mu bingi, n'okuba n'obujjuvu bw'amaanyi ga Katonda.

Okumatiza omubiri n'obujjuvu bw'Omwoyo tebitambulira wamu. "Kubanga omubiri gwegomba ebikontana n'Omwoyo, n'Omwoyo ebikontana n'omubiri. Bino byombi bikontana." (Abaggalatiya 5:17) Pawulo yawandiika nti, "Nkuba omubiri gwange ne nguleeta mu buddu." (1 Abakkolinso 9:27, Abaefeso 5:18.).

Tuli balamu mu kiseera okukemebwa okumatiza omubiri kwe kunene ennyo.

Ebintu eby'ebbeeyi bya bulijjo. Obwesigwa n'okuyimirira obulungi bitambulira wamu, era mu bifo bingi, okuyimirira obulungi obwavudde mu bwesigwa n'amaanyi kwe kwazikiriza omuntu gwe kwajjira. Abaweereza abalina amaanyi si batono abafuuse ba kitiibwa era abanoonyezebwa. Nga okwatiikirira kw'eyongera, ne wajja n'okweyongera kw'empeera n'okwesiima kw'obulamu. Obulamu obw'ebbeeyi ne buyingira, n'amaanyi g'Omwoyo ne gafuluma. Tekyandibadde kizibu kuwa byokulabirako bya lwatu ku mazima gano agasaddaaza. Bwe twandyagadde okumanya okusigala kw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo, twetaaga okwekuuma tulyoke tube n'obulamu obwangu, obutaliimu kwewembera na kukkuta kungi, nga bulijjo tuli beetegefu "okugumiikiriza okubonaabona, ng'omuserikale omulungi owa Yesu Kristo." (2 Timoseewo 2:3) Nnyatula mu lwatu nti ntya obulamu obw'ebbeeyi; sibutya nga bwe ntya ekibi, naye buddirira ng'ekintu eky'okutya. Muliraanwa mulungi ennyo naye omulabe w'amaanyi ow'amaanyi ennyo.

Waliwo baddayimooni leero "abatagenda okuggyako lwa kusaba na kusiiba."

Amaanyi gafiirwa okuyita mu mululu gw'ensimbi. Kyali kuyita mu kino omu ku kibiina ky'Abatume ab'olubereberye, ekkumi n'ababiri Yesu yennyini be yalonda okuba nawe, kwe yagweramu.

Okwagala ensimbi, okwagala okutereka, kwayingira mu mutima gwa Yuda Isukalyoti, ne kumuzikiriza. "Kubanga okwagala ensimbi kwe kikolo eky'ebibi byonna," (1 Timoseewo 6:10), naye kimu ku bibi ebisinga obunene bye kiva mu kwo kwe kufiirwa amaanyi ag'omwoyo.

Basajja bameka leero abaamala okumanya amaanyi g'Omwoyo, naye ne bagafiirwa obugagga bwe bwajja.

Mangu ago yawulira okusikirira kwabwo okw'ekyewuunyo. Okwagala okutereka, omululu, okwagala okweyongerayo, mpolampola, kwatwala omutima gwe. Yakuŋŋaanya ensimbi ze mu bwesimbu, naye zimumaze, era Omwoyo wa Katonda aggaliddwa ebweru, era amaanyi ge gagenze.

Abasajja abaali baagala okubeera n'amaanyi beetaaga okuba n'ebigambo bya Kristo, "Mwekuume mwewale omululu," nga biwandiikiddwa bulungi era nga bisimbiddwa nnyo mu mitima gyabwe. Omuntu tateekwa kuba mugagga alyoke abe n'omululu. Omusajja omwavu ennyo ayinza okwerarikirira ennyo okwegomba obugagga nga omugagga yenna ow'omululu.

4. Amaanyi gafiirwa okuyita mu malala. Guno gwe mulabe asinga okulimba era asinga obulabe ku balabe b'amaanyi bonna. Sikakasa, naye abasajja abasinga okufiirwa amaanyi gaabwe ku kifo kino okusinga ku ebyo byonna bye twogeddeko. Abasajja bangi tebakyukanga na bugenderevu ne bava ku kwewaayo kwabwe, tebalekanga kibi, mu makulu ag'okukola n'obugendereza ekyo Katonda kye yagaana oba okugaana n'obugendereza okukola ekyo Katonda kye yalagira, kuyingira mu bulamu bwabwe, tebawangako mu kwemalira, baagaana ddala, obutakoowa, era mu ngeri emu okukemebwa okw'okukuŋŋaanya ensimbi, naye era baalemwa, amalala gaayingira.

Baafuuka ab'amalala kubanga Katonda yabawa amaanyi era n'abakozesa, oboolyawo olw'obutakyukakyuka, obwangu, n'obweyamo bw'obulamu bwabwe, era olw'ekyo, Katonda yawalirizibwa okubaggyawo. Katonda tayinza kukozesa musajja wa malala (1 Peetero 5:5). "Katonda awakanya ab'amalala, naye abawombeefu abawa ekisa." Omusajja ajjudde amalala n'okwegulumiza tayinza kujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Pawulo yalaba akabi kano ku ye yennyini.

Katonda yakalabira ku ye, era "olw'obunene bw'okubikkulirwa kuno. Kyenva mpeebwa eriggwa mu mubiri gwange, omubaka wa Setaani, okunnuma, nneme okwegulumiza" (2 Abakkolinso 12:7). Basajja bameka abaalemererwa wano! Baasaba amaanyi ga Katonda mu ngeri ye; ne gajja.

Abantu baawa obujulirwa ku mukisa gwe baafuna okuyita mu Kigambo kyabwe, n'amalala ne gayingira era ne gakkirizibwa, era byonna ne bifiirwa. Musa yali musajja mugumiikiriza, naye yalemererwa ku kifo kino kyennyini. "Tunaabaggyira amazzi mu lwazi luno?" bwe yagamba, awo n'awo, Katonda n'amuggyawo (Okubala 20:10-12). Katonda bw'aba atukozesa mu ngeri yonna, katukkakkane wansi ennyo mu maaso ge.

Gy'akoma okutukozesa, gy'atuleka okukkakkana wansi. Katonda akuume ebigambo bye nga bivuga mu matu gaffe nti: "Mmwe mwenna, mwambale obuwombeefu nga bwe mweyisaamu, kubanga Katonda awakanya ab'amalala, naye abawombeefu abawa ekisa" (1 Peetero 5:5)?

5. Amaanyi gafiirwa okuyita mu kugaya okusaba. Kiba mu kusaba, naddala, mwe tujjuzibwa amaanyi ga Katonda. Omusajja asaba ennyo, amaanyi ga Katonda mwe gakulukutira n'amaanyi. Yokaana Livingston yamala ekiro n'Abakristaayo abamu mu lukuŋŋaana n'okusaba. Ku lunaku olwaddirira, nga June 21, 1630, yabuulira bw'atyo ku Kirk of Shotts, Omwoyo ne agwa ku bo abaali bamuwuliriza mu ngeri ebikumi bitaano gye baayinza okugerekera okukyusibwa kwabwe oba okunywezebwa okw'ekitalo okuva ku lunaku olwo. Kino kya kimu kyokka mu nkumi n'enkumi ebiraga engeri amaanyi gye gaweebwa mu kusaba.

Obutuukirivu oba amaanyi bulijjo gatuvaako, nga bwe gavudde ku Kristo (Makko 5:30), mu buweereza n'omukisa; era bwe twandyagadde okukuuma amaanyi, gateekwa okuddiŋŋanibwa bulijjo mu kusaba. Amasannyalaze bwe gava mu kintu ekiriko amasannyalaze, kiteekwa okuddamu okugajjuzibwamu. Bwe tutyo naffe tuteekwa okuddamu okujjuzibwamu amaanyi ga Katonda, era kino kikolebwa okuyita mu kutuukagana ne Katonda mu kusaba. Abasajja bangi Katonda be yakozesa baafuuka ab'obulagajjavu mu mpisa zaabwe ez'okusaba, Mukama n'abavaako, era n'amaanyi gaabwe ne gagenda. Tewali ku ffe abatakyalina amaanyi ge twali tulina edda, olw'obugenzi nti tetukyamala ekiseera nga tuvuunamye mu maaso ga Katonda nga bwe twakolanga edda?

6. Amaanyi gafiirwa okuyita mu kugaya Ekigambo. Amaanyi ga Katonda gajja okuyita mu kusaba, gajja n'okuyita mu Kigambo (Zabbuli 1:2-3; Yoswa 1:8). Bangi baamanya amaanyi agajja okuyita mu kufumiitiriza ku Kigambo okwa bulijjo, okulowoozebwako, okw'okusaba, era okw'ekiseera ekiwanvu, naye emirimu n'oboolyawo ebyobuvunaanyizibwa eby'Ekikristaayo bwe byeyongera, ebyokusoma ebirala ne biyingira, Ekigambo ne kisindiikirizibwa wabbali mu kigero, n'amaanyi ne gagenda. Tuteekwa okufumiitiriza buli lunaku, mu kusaba, mu buziba ku Kigambo bwe tuba tuyagala okukuuma amaanyi.

Abasajja bangi baakalira olw'okukigaya.

Ndowooza ensonga omusanvu ze twogeddeko ziwa engeri enkulu amaanyi ag'omwoyo mwe gafiirwa. Sirowooza ndala. Bwe wabaawo okutya okumu okunjijira emirundi mingi okusinga okulala kwonna, kwe kutya okufiirwa amaanyi ga Katonda. Wange, obulumi obw'okumala okumanya amaanyi ga Katonda, obw'okumala okukozesebwa Ye, n'oluvannyuma amaanyi ago n'okuggibwawo, okuggyibwawo okutuuka ne ku bugaso obwennyini bwonna.

Abantu bayinza okwongera okukutendereza, naye Katonda tayinza kukukozesa. Okulaba ensi ezikirira ekwetoolodde n'okumanya nti tewali maanyi mu bigambo byo aga kulokola. Okufa tekwandisinze ekyo?

Sitya nnyo kufiirwa bulamu obutaggwaawo. Buli mukkiriza mu Kristo aluli nabwo dda. Okubifunda, bino bye bino: okuwaayo okwawulibwa kwaffe, ekibi, okwemalira, n'omululu gw'ensimbi, amalala, okugaya okusaba, n'okugaya Ekigambo. Tetuligenda, olw'ekisa kya Katonda, okuva mu kiseera kino okwekuuma eri ebintu bino, ne tulyoke tukakase okusigala kw'amaanyi ga Katonda mu bulamu bwaffe n'obuweereza okutuusa olunaku oluli olw'essanyu lwe lulijja lwe tuliyinza okugamba ne Pawulo nti: "Nnwanye okulwana okulungi, ntuukirizza olugendo lwange, nkuumye okukkiriza; okuva kaakano nterekeddwa engule ey'obutuukirivu, Mukama, omulamuzi omutuukirivu, gy'alimpa ku lunaku luli," (2 Timoseewo 4:7-8.) Oba ekisingako obulungi, ne Yesu nti, "Nkugulumizizza ku nsi, nga ntuukirizza omulimu gwe wampa okukola."

(Yokaana 17:4.)

fields.body_text: Enkubaganya y'ebirowoozo yonna ku Kubatizibwa n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'amaanyi agava mu kwo yandibadde ng'etajjuvu singa tetwogera ku kyo nti amaanyi ag'omwoyo gayinza okufiirwa. Olumu ku lugero olw'ekitalo era olusaddaaza ennyo mu Ndagaano Enkadde lwe lwa Samusooni. Era lwe lumu ku ngeri esomesa ennyo. Yali asinga ddala okwatiikirira mu bantu b'ekiseera kye. Emikisa emikulu gyali mibikkule gy'ali, naye oluvannyuma lw'okuwangula okw'ekiseera, obulamu bwe bwakoma mu kugwa okusaddaaza, byonna olw'obusiru bwe ye. Emirundi n'emirundi kigambibwa ku ye nti "Omwoyo wa Mukama n'amukkako n'amaanyi," era olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo ogwo, yakola eby'ekyewuunyo, ng'eewuunyisa abantu be era ng'awangula abalabe ba Mukama, naye mu Balamuzi 16:19-20, tumulaba ng'alekeddwa Mukama, newankubadde nga takimanyi, amaanyi ge nga gamuvuddeko era ng'anaatera okutwalibwa mu buwambe obw'ennaku, ekyokuzannyisa eri abatatya Katonda, era n'okufa n'abalabe ba Mukama okufa okw'obukambwe era okw'obuswavu. Eky'ennaku, Samusooni si ye musajja yekka mu byafaayo by'Ekikristaayo eyamala okumanya amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, oluvannyuma n'amwolwako amaanyi gano n'aggibwako. Waaliwo ba Samusooni bangi, era ndowooza waliba abasajja abalala bangi Katonda be yamala okukozesa oluvannyuma n'awalirizibwa okubaggyako. Kimu ku bintu ebisaddaaza ennyo ku nsi kwe kulaba omusajja bw'atyo. Katutunuulire ekiseera Mukama lw'ava ku muntu oba lw'amuggyako amaanyi ge, oba mu ngeri endala, "Engeri amaanyi gye gafiirwa." I. Okusooka, Katonda aggya amaanyi ge ku basajja bwe bakyuka ne bava ku kwawulibwa kwabwe eri Ye. Kino kye kyali ddala eri Samusooni yennyini. (Balamuzi 16:19, Okubala 6:2, 5). Enviiri ze ezitaasalibwako kye kyali ekyokulabikira eky'obweyamo bwe obw'Obunaziri, kwe yali "yeeyawulira Mukama." Okusala enviiri ze kwe kwali okuwaayo okwawulibwa kwe. Okwawulibwa kwe kwaggibwawo; n'aggyibwako amaanyi ge. Ku kifo kino kye kimu abasajja bangi leero bagibwako amaanyi gaabwe. Waaliwo olunaku lwe yeeyawulira Katonda. Yakuba amabega eri ensi n'okwegomba kwayo, omwoyo gwayo, ebigendererwa byayo; ne yeeteeka wa ku bbali eri Katonda ng'omutukuvu gy'ali, okuba owuwe, Katonda amutwale amukozese era amukole ky'ayagala. Katonda yassaamu ekitiibwa okwawulibwa kwe. Yamusiiga amafuta g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'amaanyi. Yamanyiira Katonda. Naye Derira n'amujjira. Ensi n'ewamba omutima gwe nate. Yawuliriza eddoboozi ly'ensi eriwabya n'akkiriza n'amumwako akabonero k'okwawulibwa. Yali takyali musajja yawuddwa, oba omutukuvu ddala eri Mukama, era Mukama n'amuleka. Tewali bantu ng'abo mu abo abasoma kino? Basajja ne bakazi, Mukama be yamala okukozesa, naye kaakano takyabakozesa. Muyinza okuba nga mukyali mu mulimu ogw'Ekikristaayo mu maaso, naye tewali ddembe n'amaanyi ag'edda mu gwo, era ensonga eno kubanga mubadde batali beesigwa eri okwawulibwa kwammwe, eri okwewaayo kwammwe eri Katonda; muwuliriza Derira, eddoboozi ly'omwenzi, ensi n'okukemebwa kwayo. Wandyagadde okukomyawo amaanyi ag'edda? Waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka eky'okukola. Leka enviiri zo zikule nate, nga Samusooni bwe yakola. Zza obuggya okwewaayo kwo eri Katonda. 2. Amaanyi gafiirwa okuyita mu kuyingira kw'ekibi. Kyali bwe kityo eri Sawulo, mutabani wa Kiisi. Omwoyo wa Katonda ne akka ku Sawulo, n'awangula okuwangula okunene ku lwa Katonda. (1 Samwiri 11:6). Yatwala abantu ba Katonda okubatuusa mu kifo eky'obuwanguzi ku balabe baabwe, abaali babanyigirizza okumala emyaka. Naye Sawulo yajeemera Katonda mu bifo bibiri eby'enjawulo (1 Samwiri 13-14, 9-11, 23), Mukama n'amuggyako ekisa kye n'amaanyi ge, era obulamu bwa Sawulo ne bukoma mu kuwangulwa n'okuzikirira kwenkanidde. Kino kye kyafaayo eky'abasajja bangi Katonda be yamala okukozesa. Ekibi kyayingira. Baakola ekyo Katonda kye yabagamba obutakola, oba baagaana okukola ekyo Katonda kye yabalagira okukola, era amaanyi ga Katonda ne gaggibwawo. Oyo eyamala okumanya amaanyi ga Katonda mu buweereza era ayagala okugeeyongera okugamanya ateekwa okutambula n'obwegendereza ennyo mu maaso ge. Ateekwa okuba nga awuliriza bulijjo okuwulira Katonda ky'amulagira okukola oba obutakola. Ateekwa okuyanukula amangu eri obuŋŋunda obutono ennyo obwa Katonda. Kandirabise nga omuntu yenna eyamala okumanya amaanyi ga Katonda yandisinze okufa okusinga okugafiirwa. Naye gafiirwa okuyita mu kuyingira kw'ekibi. Waliwo ku basoma ekitabo kino abayita mu kyokutegeera kino eky'entiisa eky'okufiirwa amaanyi ga Katonda? Weebuuze oba eno y'ensonga; ekibi kiyingidde wamu? Okola ekintu, oboolyawo ekintu ekitono, Katonda ky'akugamba obutakola? Ogaya ekintu Katonda kye yakusaba okukola? Kituukirize kino ekigambo ne Katonda, era amaanyi ag'edda galikomawo. Dawudi yazza omusango ogw'ekibi eky'entiisa, naye ekibi ekyo bwe kyayatulwa ne kiggyibwawo, yaddamu okumanya amaanyi g'Omwoyo. (Zabbuli 32:1-5; Zabbuli 51:11-13). Bwe twandyagadde okumanya obutasalako amaanyi ga Katonda, twandigenze emirundi mingi twekka ne Ye, waakiri ku nkomerero ya buli lunaku, ne tumusaba atulage oba waliwo ekibi kyonna, ekintu kyonna ekitasanyusa mu maaso ge, ekiyingidde ku lunaku olwo, era bw'atulaga nti waliwo, twandikyatudde ne tukiggyawo mu kiseera ekyo kyennyini. 3. Amaanyi gafiirwa nate okuyita mu kwemalira. Oyo ayagala amaanyi ga Katonda ateekwa okubeera n'obulamu obw'okwefiiriza. Waliwo ebintu bingi ebitali bibi mu ngeri gy'ekigambo ekibi bwe kitera okutegeerebwa, naye ebiziyiza obw'omwoyo era ebiggya abasajja amaanyi. Sikkiriza nti omuntu yenna ayinza okubeera n'obulamu obw'ebbeeyi, okwewemberako mu kwegomba kwe okw'obuzaale, okwenyumiriza mu bingi, n'okuba n'obujjuvu bw'amaanyi ga Katonda. Okumatiza omubiri n'obujjuvu bw'Omwoyo tebitambulira wamu. "Kubanga omubiri gwegomba ebikontana n'Omwoyo, n'Omwoyo ebikontana n'omubiri. Bino byombi bikontana." (Abaggalatiya 5:17) Pawulo yawandiika nti, "Nkuba omubiri gwange ne nguleeta mu buddu." (1 Abakkolinso 9:27, Abaefeso 5:18.). Tuli balamu mu kiseera okukemebwa okumatiza omubiri kwe kunene ennyo. Ebintu eby'ebbeeyi bya bulijjo. Obwesigwa n'okuyimirira obulungi bitambulira wamu, era mu bifo bingi, okuyimirira obulungi obwavudde mu bwesigwa n'amaanyi kwe kwazikiriza omuntu gwe kwajjira. Abaweereza abalina amaanyi si batono abafuuse ba kitiibwa era abanoonyezebwa. Nga okwatiikirira kw'eyongera, ne wajja n'okweyongera kw'empeera n'okwesiima kw'obulamu. Obulamu obw'ebbeeyi ne buyingira, n'amaanyi g'Omwoyo ne gafuluma. Tekyandibadde kizibu kuwa byokulabirako bya lwatu ku mazima gano agasaddaaza. Bwe twandyagadde okumanya okusigala kw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo, twetaaga okwekuuma tulyoke tube n'obulamu obwangu, obutaliimu kwewembera na kukkuta kungi, nga bulijjo tuli beetegefu "okugumiikiriza okubonaabona, ng'omuserikale omulungi owa Yesu Kristo." (2 Timoseewo 2:3) Nnyatula mu lwatu nti ntya obulamu obw'ebbeeyi; sibutya nga bwe ntya ekibi, naye buddirira ng'ekintu eky'okutya. Muliraanwa mulungi ennyo naye omulabe w'amaanyi ow'amaanyi ennyo. Waliwo baddayimooni leero "abatagenda okuggyako lwa kusaba na kusiiba." Amaanyi gafiirwa okuyita mu mululu gw'ensimbi. Kyali kuyita mu kino omu ku kibiina ky'Abatume ab'olubereberye, ekkumi n'ababiri Yesu yennyini be yalonda okuba nawe, kwe yagweramu. Okwagala ensimbi, okwagala okutereka, kwayingira mu mutima gwa Yuda Isukalyoti, ne kumuzikiriza. "Kubanga okwagala ensimbi kwe kikolo eky'ebibi byonna," (1 Timoseewo 6:10), naye kimu ku bibi ebisinga obunene bye kiva mu kwo kwe kufiirwa amaanyi ag'omwoyo. Yakuŋŋaanya ensimbi ze mu bwesimbu, naye zimumaze, era Omwoyo wa Katonda aggaliddwa ebweru, era amaanyi ge gagenze. Omuntu tateekwa kuba mugagga alyoke abe n'omululu. Omusajja omwavu ennyo ayinza okwerarikirira ennyo okwegomba obugagga nga omugagga yenna ow'omululu. 4. Amaanyi gafiirwa okuyita mu malala. Guno gwe mulabe asinga okulimba era asinga obulabe ku balabe b'amaanyi bonna. Sikakasa, naye abasajja abasinga okufiirwa amaanyi gaabwe ku kifo kino okusinga ku ebyo byonna bye twogeddeko. Baafuuka ab'amalala kubanga Katonda yabawa amaanyi era n'abakozesa, oboolyawo olw'obutakyukakyuka, obwangu, n'obweyamo bw'obulamu bwabwe, era olw'ekyo, Katonda yawalirizibwa okubaggyawo. Katonda tayinza kukozesa musajja wa malala (1 Peetero 5:5). "Katonda awakanya ab'amalala, naye abawombeefu abawa ekisa." Omusajja ajjudde amalala n'okwegulumiza tayinza kujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Pawulo yalaba akabi kano ku ye yennyini. Katonda yakalabira ku ye, era "olw'obunene bw'okubikkulirwa kuno. Kyenva mpeebwa eriggwa mu mubiri gwange, omubaka wa Setaani, okunnuma, nneme okwegulumiza" (2 Abakkolinso 12:7). Basajja bameka abaalemererwa wano! Baasaba amaanyi ga Katonda mu ngeri ye; ne gajja. Abantu baawa obujulirwa ku mukisa gwe baafuna okuyita mu Kigambo kyabwe, n'amalala ne gayingira era ne gakkirizibwa, era byonna ne bifiirwa. Musa yali musajja mugumiikiriza, naye yalemererwa ku kifo kino kyennyini. "Tunaabaggyira amazzi mu lwazi luno?" bwe yagamba, awo n'awo, Katonda n'amuggyawo (Okubala 20:10-12). Katonda bw'aba atukozesa mu ngeri yonna, katukkakkane wansi ennyo mu maaso ge. Gy'akoma okutukozesa, gy'atuleka okukkakkana wansi. Katonda akuume ebigambo bye nga bivuga mu matu gaffe nti: "Mmwe mwenna, mwambale obuwombeefu nga bwe mweyisaamu, kubanga Katonda awakanya ab'amalala, naye abawombeefu abawa ekisa" (1 Peetero 5:5)? 5. Amaanyi gafiirwa okuyita mu kugaya okusaba. Kiba mu kusaba, naddala, mwe tujjuzibwa amaanyi ga Katonda. Omusajja asaba ennyo, amaanyi ga Katonda mwe gakulukutira n'amaanyi. Yokaana Livingston yamala ekiro n'Abakristaayo abamu mu lukuŋŋaana n'okusaba. Ku lunaku olwaddirira, nga June 21, 1630, yabuulira bw'atyo ku Kirk of Shotts, Omwoyo ne agwa ku bo abaali bamuwuliriza mu ngeri ebikumi bitaano gye baayinza okugerekera okukyusibwa kwabwe oba okunywezebwa okw'ekitalo okuva ku lunaku olwo. Kino kya kimu kyokka mu nkumi n'enkumi ebiraga engeri amaanyi gye gaweebwa mu kusaba. Obutuukirivu oba amaanyi bulijjo gatuvaako, nga bwe gavudde ku Kristo (Makko 5:30), mu buweereza n'omukisa; era bwe twandyagadde okukuuma amaanyi, gateekwa okuddiŋŋanibwa bulijjo mu kusaba. Amasannyalaze bwe gava mu kintu ekiriko amasannyalaze, kiteekwa okuddamu okugajjuzibwamu. Bwe tutyo naffe tuteekwa okuddamu okujjuzibwamu amaanyi ga Katonda, era kino kikolebwa okuyita mu kutuukagana ne Katonda mu kusaba. Abasajja bangi Katonda be yakozesa baafuuka ab'obulagajjavu mu mpisa zaabwe ez'okusaba, Mukama n'abavaako, era n'amaanyi gaabwe ne gagenda.
